Agent / contributor instructions for rtfreporter

Source: AGENTS.md

This repository is the R package (DESCRIPTION is at the root). This file is a short orientation for agents and new contributors; the detailed, authoritative docs are linked below.

Read these first

Topic Document
Architecture & internals (the big picture, source-file map) vignettes/articles/architecture.Rmd
Adding a new table-object source (gt / rtables / …) vignettes/articles/extending-adapters.Rmd
Contribution workflow, code style, branching, versioning & releases CONTRIBUTING.md
In-depth design specs (English, with -ja toggle) vignettes/articles/internal-design.Rmd, architecture.Rmd

There is no longer a separate specs/ folder — those documents above are the single source of truth. If a doc and the code disagree, fix whichever is wrong (open an issue if the design itself is in question).

Invariants — do not break

  • S3 throughout. Every object is a plain S3 list; no R6 (removed in v0.0.19).
  • Zero hard runtime dependencies. Imports: is methods only. Every optional integration (gt, gtsummary, rtables/tern, ggplot2, …) lives in Suggests: and is reached through requireNamespace().
  • twips only (1 inch = 1440 twips) as the internal length unit.
  • ASCII-only R code (use \uXXXX escapes); non-ASCII is fine in comments and roxygen, not in code.
  • NAMESPACE is hand-managed. Regenerate man/*.Rd with devtools::document() and commit them.
  • The three packages. Dependencies point one way: rtfreporter <- tflspec <- tflplanner. rtfreporter knows nothing of the other two.
  • Fictional data only. No company, study or patient data in code, tests, fixtures, examples, issues or pull requests, and none sent to an AI service.

Tests and code

  • No withr (it is not a dependency): use tempfile(), dir.create() and on.exit(unlink(...)).
  • While you work, run the tests of the area you changed and lintr on the changed files; before you push, the four pre-push checks (Pull requests in CONTRIBUTING.md).
  • Run tests where they are; never copy them into a temporary folder (testthat would read that folder’s setup*.R).
  • Point R_USER_CONFIG_DIR, R_USER_DATA_DIR and R_USER_CACHE_DIR at a work folder, never at the user’s own.
  • Run the tests in one R session too (testthat::test_dir() on the installed package), not only one file at a time: per-file runs miss interference between tests.
  • Split a source file before it passes 2,000 lines.

Workflow

  1. Branch off main (see Branching & collaboration in CONTRIBUTING.md). If you work for a contributor, you do the git work too: Git work for a contributor in inst/ai/rtfreporter-ai-dev-manual.md (updating the fork, rebasing a topic branch, what to do when CI or a review asks).

  2. Change R/, tests/testthat/, and the roxygen docs together.

  3. Run devtools::document(), then the four pre-push checks listed in Pull requests in CONTRIBUTING.md (set-up: Development setup there).

  4. Record the change in the PR description. A PR never edits NEWS.md, CHANGELOG.md or Version:, and there is no separate memo file. Fill the template’s User-visible change (for NEWS) field without being asked: one or two bullets in NEWS style (what a user can now do, or what is fixed, named by its function or argument), or “none” for an internal change; then “Breaking: no”, or “Breaking: yes” with the migration. The maintainers write NEWS.md from the merged PRs at release. For example:

    ## User-visible change (for NEWS)

- `rtfplot()` and `rtf_figures()` take `render_format = "emf"`: a plot object is
  drawn as EMF with devEMF (in Suggests), at `render_width` x `render_height`
  inches.

Breaking: no

  5. Open a pull request against main.

Every behaviour change needs a requirement in inst/validation/requirements.csv and a test named with its FT id (or a traceability_matrix.csv row for an existing test), in the same PR, with validation/trace.R and the validation tests passing and a deviations.csv row where a test is not possible; see Quality assurance in CONTRIBUTING.md for the full rule.

Versioning. Standard R scheme: a release is X.Y.Z, development is X.Y.Z.9000, and the three-component part names the last release. The maintainers set the version when they tag or release; a PR leaves Version: alone, and version-guard accepts a PR with no version change. Touching X, Y or Z is a release action and fails version-guard without the release label. See Versioning & releases in CONTRIBUTING.md.

Layout (standard R-package set)

R/            man/            tests/testthat/    vignettes/ (+ articles/)
inst/         data-raw/       pkgdown/           .github/
DESCRIPTION   NAMESPACE       NEWS.md  CHANGELOG.md  README.md  LICENSE

The authoritative per-file map lives in the architecture article above. data-raw/ holds developer-only scripts (sample-data prep + demo generators); it is .Rbuildignored and never shipped.

Tests

devtools::test()    # all tests must pass before merging to main

The full list of pre-push checks is in Pull requests in CONTRIBUTING.md.
